composites.name: dfba-textbook-demo
composites.description: Tiny well-mixed dynamic FBA demo using cobra's `textbook` E. coli model. Each step solves FBA with Michaelis-Menten uptake bounds, updates biomass/media by explicit Euler, and emits scalar + map signals.

interval.description: Process interval in hours. The pure-Python dFBA bridge breaks this into substep-sized FBA solves.

substep.description: Internal Euler integration step (hr). Smaller is more accurate.

composites.name: dfba-textbook-with-viz
composites.description: Dynamic FBA demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar + per-species trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.
